;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]], [[2017 Aleppo suicide car bombing]]
**A car bomb strikes a convoy of buses near [[Aleppo]] which were carrying evacuees from the pro-government towns of [[Al-Fu'ah]] and [[Kafriya]]. Over 100 people are killed. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-39609288 (BBC)] [https://www.yahoo.com/news/thousands-evacuated-syrians-stuck-transfer-stalls-095402714.html (AP via Yahoo! News)]
*[[South Sudanese Civil War]]
**At least 16 people are killed amid fresh fighting in [[Raga, South Sudan|Raga]], according to a [[Sudan People's Liberation Movement-in-Opposition|SPLM-IO]] spokesperson. The [[United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs]] said that over 60 humanitarian aid workers were forced to flee. [http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/04/fighting-south-sudan-raga-kills-14-people-170415132143449.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2017 Nangarhar airstrike]]
**The death toll according to a [[Nangarhar Province|Nangarhar]] official source now stands at 94 militants, including 4 commanders. Former president [[Hamid Karzai]] says the strike was in violation of national sovereignty. [http://www.tolonews.com/afghanistan/four-daesh-commanders-killed-us-bombing-achin (TOLOnews)]
*The Chief Public Prosecutor’s Office in [[Istanbul]] launches an investigation into 17 [[United States]] citizens in connection with the [[2016 Turkish coup d'état attempt|2016 Turkish ''coup d'état'' attempt]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/chuck-schumer-john-brennan-named-in-investigation-of-turkish-coup-erdogan-gulen-a7685451.html (''The Independent'')]

;Arts and culture
*[[Emma Morano]], the last person living who was born before 1900, dies at the age of 117. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-italy-oldest-idUSKBN17H0JH?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2017 Northwest Iran floods]]
**Flash flooding caused by torrential rain leaves at least 17 people dead and 20 others missing in northwestern [[Iran]], according to state television. [http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/04/flash-floods-kill-17-northwest-iran-170415071058182.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Law and crime
*[[Personal and business legal affairs of Donald Trump]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s lawyers tell a federal court, in a [[Personal and business legal affairs of Donald Trump#Lawsuit for inciting violence at March 2016 campaign rally|case]] alleging [[negligence]] and [[incitement#United States|incitement to riot]] during a [[Donald Trump 2016 presidential campaign#Violence, protests and expulsions at rallies|2016 campaign rally]] in [[Louisville, Kentucky]], that he is "immune from suit because he is President of the United States." A lawyer for the plaintiffs responds that, in ''[[Clinton v. Jones]]'', the [[Supreme Court of the United States|Supreme Court]] found the president could be sued for events that occurred before he took office. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/the-fix/wp/2017/04/15/trump-says-he-cant-be-sued-for-violence-at-his-rallies-because-he-won-the-election/ (''The Washington Post'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[First presidency of Donald Trump|Presidency of Donald Trump]]
**[[Protests against Donald Trump]], [[Tax March|Tax Day March]]
***Tens of thousands of people march in dozens of U.S. cities and at President [[Donald Trump]]'s [[Mar-a-Lago]] resort in [[Palm Beach, Florida]], to demand that Trump release [[Tax returns of Donald Trump|his tax returns]] and to show the public cares about the issue. There were clashes between Trump supporters and protesters at some locations, with 11 people injured and 21 arrested at [[2017 Berkeley protests#April 15|a riot]] in [[Berkeley, California]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2017/04/15/us/politics/tax-day-protests-trump-returns.html?_r=0 (''The New York Times'')] [http://in.reuters.com/article/usa-trump-taxes-idINKBN17I032 (Reuters)] [http://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-ln-berkeley-trump-rally-20170415-story.html (''Los Angeles Times'')]
** [[Vice President of the United States|United States Vice President]] [[Mike Pence]] visits [[Alaska]], where he meets with [[Governor of Alaska|Governor]] [[Bill Walker (American politician)|Bill Walker]] and discusses stationing [[F-35]] squadrons in the state. Pence is beginning a 10-day trip to [[South Korea]], [[Australia]], [[Indonesia]] and [[Japan]]. [https://www.usnews.com/news/best-states/alaska/articles/2017-04-15/pence-meets-with-alaska-governor-ahead-of-asia-trip (''US News & World Report'')]
*[[Iranian presidential election, 2017]]
**[[Tehran]] [[Mayor of Tehran|Mayor]] [[Mohammad-Bagher Ghalibaf]] and [[Vice President of Iran|First Vice President]] [[Eshaq Jahangiri]] submit their candidacies as registration closes. The final list of approved candidates will be announced on April 27. [http://en.mehrnews.com/news/124795/Pre-Guardian-Council-final-list-becomes-exhaustive (Mehr News)]
